datasets.variant_notes: Includes shared instructions adapted from original IFEval plus novel language-specific instructions for each of the 3 target languages. 115 prompts for Spanish, 235 for French, 172 for Japanese.
datasets.source_language: English (for shared instructions adapted from IFEval); French, Japanese, Spanish (for language-specific instructions created natively)

data_creator_info.evidence: We chose French, Japanese, and Spanish as our research team included one native speaker in each language, with each acting as language lead for their respective language.

datasets.notes: Prompts were developed by generating multiple example prompts using an LLM, then manually selecting and editing. Shared instructions from IFEval were adapted per language (e.g., case-change instructions removed for Japanese). Language-specific instructions were newly created by native-speaker language leads. English scores are from the original IFEval and not newly collected.
